name: View card
description: A capture, a recording or a picture to open, as a card: the picture letterboxed over a blurred copy of itself, a recording's length in the corner, and its title, details, badges and actions revealed on hover. For a screenshot history, a media library or a gallery of exports.

classes.ayy-view-card: Root: a card frame that clips the picture to its corners. Positioned, so Hover actions can float in its corners.
classes.ayy-view-card__media: The picture's box at --ayy-ratio (default 16 / 10). A <button> or <a> when opening it is the card's main action.
classes.ayy-view-card__backdrop: A blurred copy of the picture filling the box around the letterboxed picture (aria-hidden).
classes.ayy-view-card__image: The picture itself, letterboxed (object-fit: contain), never cropped.
classes.ayy-view-card__badge: Frosted pill in the top start corner: a recording's kind and length ("0:42").
classes.ayy-view-card__play: Frosted round play glyph in the top end corner. Fades when the card is hovered so the actions can take the corner.
classes.ayy-view-card__body: Title, details and badges on a gradient over the bottom of the picture. Revealed on hover; clicks go through to the picture.
classes.ayy-view-card__text: Column of the title and the details; truncates.
classes.ayy-view-card__title: The card's name in sm semibold, one line.
classes.ayy-view-card__meta: Details in xs soft text with tabular figures: size, length, age.
classes.ayy-view-card__badges: Row of Badges at the end of the body (Edited, Uploaded).

default.looks: The picture, letterboxed over its blurred copy, in a card with a hairline border. Only the badge and the play glyph show.

hover.when: .ayy-view-card:hover (pointer devices); [data-hover] does the same when hover is tracked elsewhere
hover.looks: The border darkens and the card lifts to the raised shadow. The body fades up from 6px below, a --reveal Hover actions row fades in, and the play glyph fades out.

pressed.none: The picture opens on click; there's no pressed look. Hover actions have their own.

focus.looks: 2px --ayy-color-ring outline inside the picture's edge. Focus anywhere in the card reveals the body and actions, like hover.

disabled.none: Don't show a card that can't be opened; say why in an Empty state or an Alert.

selected.none: A View card opens one thing. For picking several, use Grid (GridItemSelect) with an Action bar.

error.none: Show a failed load or save in an Alert or a toast, not on the card.

loading.none: Show a Skeleton in the card's shape (aspect-ratio 16 / 10) with aria-busy on the grid while the list loads.

menu-open.when: :has([aria-expanded="true"]), a menu inside it is open
menu-open.looks: Stays revealed while its ⋯ menu is open.

sizes.density: Fixed card layout; the badge, play glyph and Hover actions follow --ayy-size-control-sm (28px compact, 32px comfortable, 40px touch).
sizes.width: Fills its column: put View cards in .ayy-grid with --ayy-min (14–16rem). The picture's box is --ayy-ratio of that width.

js: viewCardClass({ className? }) → string; viewCardPlayIcon (the play glyph's SVG markup)

react.import: import { ViewCard, ViewCardMedia, ViewCardImage, ViewCardBadge, ViewCardPlay, ViewCardBody, ViewCardText, ViewCardTitle, ViewCardMeta, ViewCardBadges } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

ViewCardMedia.renders: <button class="ayy-view-card__media"> when given onClick, <a> with href, otherwise <div>

props.ratio: number | string — the box's shape, width ÷ height (1.6, or "1440 / 900"); default 16 / 10 so a grid lines up

ViewCardImage.renders: + (src, alt, width and height go on the picture)

props.backdrop: string — a smaller copy for the blurred fill; default src

ViewCardPlay.renders: <span class="ayy-view-card__play" aria-hidden="true"> with a play icon

a11y: When the picture opens something, ViewCardMedia is a <button> or <a> with an aria-label that names the item and the action ("Annotate the pricing page capture from 2 minutes ago"): the body is decoration on top of it.
The body and actions are revealed by focus as well as hover, and always shown on touch screens, so nothing is hover-only.
Give the picture's an alt only when the card has no label that already names it; the backdrop is aria-hidden.
Every Hover action needs a label (it's also the tooltip).
do: Use View cards for captures, recordings and pictures people open: a screenshot history, a media library, exported files.
Put them in .ayy-grid with --ayy-min so columns follow the window.
Pass the picture's real width and height to its ; keep the box at 16 / 10 in a grid so rows line up — portrait pictures letterbox over the blur.
Group three or more actions in one Hover actions bar (top end, group, reveal) and end it with a ⋯ DropdownMenu.
Show a recording's length in ViewCardBadge and add ViewCardPlay so it reads as playable before hover.
dont: Don't use a View card for records people select in bulk — use Grid with GridItemSelect and an Action bar.
Don't use it for text content (articles, projects) — use Card.
Don't crop the picture (object-fit: cover) — captures must show whole; the blurred copy fills the gap.
Don't put essential information only in the body: it hides until hover on pointer devices. Name the item in the media's aria-label too.
